verdict.rationale: The evidence shows public search of completed register entries, submitted documents and register announcements (Registerbekanntmachungen). Nothing documents a way to check the status of a pending filing, application or case. Searching published entries only reveals the outcome after registration, so it is an adjacent capability and earns no credit toward status tracking.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
